probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Outkast ® Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Menu Outkast ® Close Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast The first hour of a bad morning When a story goes wrong, the first sixty minutes decide whether it runs once or runs for a week. Published 30 June 2026 Reading time 2 min read Most of our reputation work happens before anything goes wrong: the audit, the holding statements, the training. But every so often the phone rings at six in the morning, and then it is all about the next hour. Minute zero: find out what is true Before anyone writes anything, we need the facts, and only the facts we can confirm. What happened, when, who was affected and what has already been done. We write them down in a shared document in short sentences. Anything we are not sure of goes in a separate list. Minute fifteen: agree who speaks One person speaks for the company, and everyone else knows it. Usually it is the founder or the most senior person who understands the problem.
